主要内容: FTI Consulting, Inc. (NYSE: FCN) announced on January 13, 2022, that 26 professionals from its Corporate Finance & Restructuring segment were named to the Who’s Who Legal: Restructuring & Insolvency 2022 list. FTI Consulting had the most professionals named to the list, which recognizes top restructuring and insolvency practitioners globally. The honorees were selected based on their experience advising clients on insolvency proceedings, corporate restructurings, liquidations, and distressed transactions. David Griffin, Joseph Hansell, and Andrew Morrison were recognized as Global Elite Thought Leaders for Restructuring & Insolvency, having received the highest number of peer nominations. The list includes senior managing directors from various locations, including Los Angeles, Melbourne, Toronto, Hong Kong, London, and Sydney. FTI Consulting is a global business advisory firm with over 6,600 employees in 29 countries, generating $2.46 billion in revenues during fiscal year 2020.
